Package io.kroxylicious.proxy.proxyprotocol

Interface ClientProxyProtocolContext

public interface ClientProxyProtocolContext
Exposes PROXY protocol information about the client-to-proxy connection to plugins, for example using FilterContext.clientProxyProtocolContext(). This is implemented by the runtime for use by plugins.

For the TCP connections currently supported by Kroxylicious, the addresses returned by this interface are InetSocketAddress instances carrying the IP address and port. The getHostName() caveat documented on FilterContext.clientAddress() applies to them too.

These are unauthenticated values claimed by the immediate peer. Kroxylicious does not verify that they reflect the true origin of the connection. Treat them as untrusted unless the immediate peer is a trusted PROXY protocol sender and untrusted clients cannot reach the listener directly. See FilterContext.clientAddress() for the full trust discussion.
